}

.acne-content a {

    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(141, 104, 40, 0.35);
    transition: 0.3s ease;
}

.acne-content a:hover {
    color: #b48635;
    border-color: #b48635;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   INTRO
----------------------------------------- */

.acne-intro {
    max-width: 1050px;
}

.acne-intro p {
    color: #4c4641;
    font-size: 21px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   ACNE TYPES
----------------------------------------- */

.acne-type-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

    margin-top: 35px;
}

.acne-type-card {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 165px;
    padding: 28px;
    background: #fff;

    border-radius: 4px;

}

.acne-type-card:hover {

}

.acne-type-card span {

    color: #a0782d;

}

.acne-type-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    color: #382d26;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.3;
}

.acne-type-card p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   NOTE
----------------------------------------- */

.acne-note {
    margin-top: 35px;
    padding: 30px 35px;
    background: #eee9e2;

}

.acne-note p:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   CAUSES
----------------------------------------- */

.acne-causes {
    margin-top: 40px;
    border-top: 1px solid #ddd4c9;
}

.acne-cause-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr;
    gap: 25px;
    padding: 27px 5px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd4c9;
}

.acne-cause-item > span {
    color: #a0782d;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 24px;
}

.acne-cause-item h3 {
    margin: 0 0 7px;
    color: #382d26;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.acne-cause-item p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.7;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   BENEFITS
----------------------------------------- */

.acne-benefits-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

.acne-benefit-card {
    padding: 30px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e8e0d6;
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.acne-benefit-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(57, 43, 32, 0.08);
}

.acne-benefit-number {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    color: #a0782d;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 20px;
}

.acne-benefit-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 12px;
    color: #382d26;
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.acne-benefit-card p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}


/* -----------------------------------------

----------------------------------------- */

.acne-treatment-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 22px;

.acne-treatment-card {

.acne-treatment-top h3 {

    color: #382d26;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 27px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.acne-treatment-card p {
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   SUB OPTIONS
----------------------------------------- */

.acne-sub-options {
    margin-top: 25px;

.acne-sub-option {
    margin-top: 15px;

.acne-why-item h3 {

.acne-final-cta {

.acne-final-cta::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    width: 330px;
    height: 330px;
    right: -140px;
    top: -140px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(196, 153, 71, 0.25);
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.acne-final-cta::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    width: 230px;
    height: 230px;
    left: -120px;
    bottom: -120px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(196, 153, 71, 0.18);
    border-radius: 50%;

.acne-final-cta .acne-label {
    color: #c99c4a;
}

.acne-final-cta h2 {
    color: #fff;

.acne-final-cta p {

    z-index: 1;

    margin-right: auto;

.acne-cta {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;

    padding: 15px 28px;

        padding: 24px;

    .acne-treatment-top h3 {

        padding: 24px;

    .acne-why-item {
        grid-template-columns: 45px 1fr;
        gap: 15px;
        padding: 28px 0;
    }

    .acne-why-item > span {
        font-size: 22px;
    }

    .acne-why-item h3 {
        font-size: 21px;
    }

    .acne-final-cta {
        margin-top: 60px;
        padding: 40px 22px;
    }

}

contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Acne Treatment

Glow and turn back time with medical-grade aesthetics.

Acne can be much more than just puberty marks and has the power to reduce your confidence substantially. At Reviva Skin and Surgery Clinic in Delhi NCR , you will receive end-to-end support for acne treatment and scar removal using various technologies and techniques. Experts at The Reviva clinic understand your issue and offer practical, tailored plans for acne scar removal and acne treatment in Ghaziabad. Visit the clinic to get the best plan from the best dermatologist.

UNDERSTANDING ACNE

Why is acne so common?

Whether teenage breakouts or adult acne, it is a common condition experienced by all, and reasons can be many, including urban stress, pollution, hormonal imbalances, irregular skincare, or the use of comedogenic products.

Acne keeps coming back; however, it is 100 per cent treatable thanks to advancements in dermatological solutions and personalised care. The dermatologist needs to know what type of acne you have to provide effective, appropriate treatment.

There are many types of acne:

01

Whiteheads & Blackheads

Comedonal Acne

02

Papules & Pustules

Inflammatory Acne

03

Nodules & Cysts

Severe Acne

04

Hormonal Acne

Often appears around the jawline and chin

05

Post-Acne Scars & Pigmentation

Long-lasting marks after acne breakouts

Sometimes people feel that it is too early to get the acne treatment, especially in the cases of teenagers, in which parents think that it will subside when the child grows. But they must understand that acne in teenagers is common, but the reason is hormonal changes, and treating it at the right time is necessary, as untreated acne can lead to marks and scars.

Treatment of acne is essential because, in most cases, acne can become severe and lead to scarring and pigmentation.

ROOT CAUSES

Causes of acne

Acne can be caused by several factors that clog pores and trigger inflammation. Understanding the cause is vital to permanently eliminating acne. Some causes of acne are:

01

Excess Oil Production

Excess oil production clogs pores and contributes to breakouts.

02

Dead Skin Cells

Dead skin cells mix with oil and block hair follicles, leading to clogged pores.

03

Bacteria

Bacteria that thrive in clogged pores can cause swelling and redness.

04

Hormonal Changes

Hormonal changes can trigger acne development, especially during puberty, periods, or stress.

05

Diet & Lifestyle

High sugar intake, processed foods, and poor skin hygiene can worsen acne breakouts.

ACNE CARE

Acne treatment – what is it?

Acne treatment in Ghaziabad is a comprehensive approach that combines medical and cosmetic solutions, tailored by a dermatologist to clear pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, and acne scars.

The main goal of the treatment is to control the breakouts, prevent future acne, and improve the skin texture. Acne treatment varies by severity, ranging from topical creams to advanced laser treatments.

The plans are customised by the dermatologist based on the skin type, age, and severity.

KEY BENEFITS

Benefits of acne treatment in Ghaziabad

Acne treatments come in many forms and depend on your tailored treatment plan. In general, acne treatment sessions are longer due to severe scarring; otherwise, results can be visible in just three to four sessions.

The treatment not only helps clear acne but also reduces the risk of recurrence. The most effective treatment, when used as part of a comprehensive plan, can help you eliminate acne permanently.

01

Clearer Skin

The acne treatment offers clearer skin by reducing blackheads, whiteheads, pimples, and active breakouts.

02

Helps Prevent Scarring

Early intervention can help reduce the risk of permanent acne scarring.

03

Customised Solutions

Expert dermatologists tailor treatment according to skin type and acne severity.

04

Long-Lasting Solutions

Advanced treatments such as laser and chemical peels target acne concerns and support long-term results.

05

Boosts Self-Confidence

Clearer skin can help people feel more confident in their social and professional life.

TREATMENT OPTIONS

Best treatment options for acne in Ghaziabad

If you seek the best acne treatment in Ghaziabad, visit Reviva Skin and Surgery Clinic to get the right treatment option as per your skin type, acne type, acne severity, and lifestyle.

01

Chemical Peels

Chemical peels are considered an effective solution for acne treatment. The chemical solution used to remove the outer dead layer of the skin leaves skin smooth, healthier, and more evenly toned.

Many types of chemical peels target different skin layers and address patients' unique needs.

Superficial or Light Peels

Modest peels that act on the skin's epidermis and are recommended for minor skin flaws.

Medium Peels

These impact the upper dermis and the epidermis and are recommended for treating deeper skin issues.

Black Peel & Other Peels

Dermatologists may use different peels or combinations depending on the severity of acne and other skin conditions.

02

Laser Acne Treatment

Laser acne treatment in Ghaziabad helps treat acne and improve its appearance. It works by penetrating the skin, reducing swelling, and enhancing collagen formation.

It works by destroying acne-causing bacteria, targeting overactive sebaceous glands, and ultimately helping improve acne scars.

It uses non-abrasive lasers to heat deeper skin layers, targeting acne bacteria and sebaceous glands.

03

Medifacials

Medifacial addresses specific skin concerns with a more targeted approach, clearing clogged pores and removing dead skin cells.

It reduces excess oil production, a crucial factor in managing acne. However, there are many types of medifacials:

Hydrafacial Carbon Laser Peel Skin Hydrating Medifacial Acne Control Medifacial Brightening Glow Medifacial
04

Prescribed Medications

Dermatologists may prescribe hormonal pills, oral antibiotics, or retinoids for severe or cystic acne.

These medications help clear current acne and prevent new breakouts. The dermatologist will prescribe these medications to achieve the treatment goals and offer smooth, clear skin without acne.

✦

However, all of the above-listed acne treatments are effective; the best option for you will be determined by your dermatologist, based on your skin type and needs. The decision will be made after the skin expert's evaluation, and the personalised treatment plan will be developed.

WHY REVIVA

Why choose Reviva Skin and Surgery Clinic in Ghaziabad for acne treatment?

Clear skin is possible at any age, regardless of acne type or severity. The best acne treatment in Ghaziabad can help you get rid of acne breakouts and also prevent future acne scars and ultimately boost your confidence in yourself.

Never wait for the condition to worsen; consult the best dermatologist at Reviva Skin and Surgery Clinic for expert care, modern technology, and customised plans. The clinic offers the best treatments for all your skin concerns and helps you achieve precise results.

If you are someone struggling for a long time with this frustrating, stubborn acne that does not respond to any medication or other treatments, visit the Reviva Skin and Surgery Clinic today for customised, personalised, FDA-approved, and proven solutions to attain and permanently regain clear, healthy skin. The dermatologists offer effective, evidence-based acne treatments using advanced technology. Rediscover clear, glowing skin with the best acne treatment in Ghaziabad—book your consultation today! Visit the best clinic in Ghaziabad today to permanently eliminate all types of acne and achieve visibly clear skin.
